_loop_guard: The workflow's evidence commit writes registry/probe_runs/** and never touches this file, so a run cannot re-trigger itself. That commit also carries [skip ci].
_trigger_note: Bump this number in the web editor and commit. That is the whole ritual — the push fires the run with the settings below.
